name: auryn-helm
summary: Helm-chart plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Render-free static parse: Chart.yaml + values.yaml become a Resource (the chart/release) that DEPENDS_ON its chart dependencies (in-repo chart else a placeholder), RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub for each values.yaml image, and MOUNTS the chart's notable ConfigValues. A deploy-helm enrichment runs the shared image lifecycle. Composes with docker/compose/k8s/terraform onto the same hub. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.
